  "public_sources": [
    {"repository": "google/jax-cfd", "path": "jax_cfd/spectral/equations.py", "git_blob": "85dbe5d32742826ee3a3ae0208fc77e0c8255ec7", "target": "NavierStokes2D.explicit_terms"},

  "finite_map": {
    "domain": "[0,2*pi)^2; nonzero integer wavevectors; output |kx|,|ky|<=K",
    "velocity": "u_hat(p)=(i*py,-i*px)*w_p/(px^2+py^2)",
    "ordered_rhs": "N(w)_k=-sum_{p+q=k} (px*qy-py*qx)/|p|^2 * w_p*w_q",
    "unordered_pair_coefficient": "(px*qy-py*qx)*(|p|^2-|q|^2)/(|p|^2*|q|^2)",
    "zero_tests": "Integer cross product zero or squared lengths equal; retain complex amplitudes otherwise.",
    "proof": "Expand -u.grad(w) in Fourier coefficients, then add the ordered (p,q) and (q,p) contributions. The p=q contribution vanishes. This is standard algebra, not a new physical model.",
    "fft": "Four real inverse FFT fields (u,v,wx,wy), physical product -(u*wx+v*wy), one forward real FFT. Pad to M=next_fast_len(3K+1)>3K, extract the same retained box."
  },
  "experiment": {
    "implementation": "Independent NumPy/SciPy/Numba reference, not actual JAX-CFD, Dedalus or spectralDNS runtime.",
    "environment": "Python 3.13.5; NumPy 2.3.5; SciPy 1.17.0; Numba 0.65.1; FFT workers=1; no fastmath; JIT warmup excluded; median of 9 timing groups; shared container.",
    "dynamic_cost": "Includes exact nonzero extraction and pair computation every RHS call. No magnitude pruning.",
    "fixed_plan_cost": "One-time plan construction reported separately; cannot reuse after support changes.",
    "K32_retained65_padded98_rows": [
      {"signed_modes":32,"fft_ms":0.6282016666669202,"dynamic_ms":0.046382600000072216},
      {"signed_modes":128,"fft_ms":0.8010614782612581,"dynamic_ms":0.0997347199998444},

      {"signed_modes":2048,"fft_ms":0.7012763809519758,"dynamic_ms":20.37391400000388}
    ],
    "all_kernel_tests_max_relative_l2_below":1.22e-15,
    "checks": "Conjugacy, instantaneous inviscid energy/enstrophy derivatives, one analytic Fourier coefficient, same-shell zero nonlinearity. Floating tests, not interval proof.",
    "integration": {
      "K":16,"viscosity":0.01,"forcing":0,"dt":0.001,"rk4_steps":5,"initial_signed_modes":8,
      "first_step_stage_supports":[8,26,80,282],"step_end_supports":[800,1088,1088,1088,1088],
      "final_relative_l2_sparse_vs_fft":1.3482178864702098e-18,
      "simple_hybrid_threshold":128,"hybrid_five_steps_ms":3.597460000008823,"fft_five_steps_ms":3.3689143333314555,
      "finding":"Exact sparsity rapidly fills; simple hybrid did not deliver end-to-end speedup. Many new nonzero coefficients are tiny."
    }
  },
  "exact_input_pruning_envelope": {
    "decomposition":"w=a+r",
    "rectangular_magnitude":"m(z)=|Re(z)|+|Im(z)|",
    "A":"sum_p ((|px|+|py|)/|p|^2)*m(z_p)",
    "B":"sum_p max(|px|,|py|)*m(z_p)",
    "bound":"sum_k |N(w)_k-N(a)_k| <= A(a)B(r)+A(r)B(a)+A(r)B(r)",
    "proof":"Use |p cross q| <= (|px|+|py|)*max(|qx|,|qy|), submultiplicativity of rectangular magnitude, expand the bilinear map at a+r, and sum. Restricting output cannot increase this absolute-sum bound.",
    "arithmetic":"Treat saved binary64 coefficient components as exact dyadic rationals; Fraction computes A,B and bound exactly. Display rounded upward.",

  },
